pokedexEntries.bk: This brutal Pokémon travels the skies on its six wings. Anything that moves seems like a foe to it, triggering its attack.

pokedexEntries.wh: The heads on their arms do not have brains. They use all three heads to consume and destroy everything.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: It responds to movement by attacking. This scary, three-headed Pokémon devours everything in its path!

pokedexEntries.sw: There are a slew of stories about villages that were destroyed by Hydreigon. It bites anything that moves.

pokedexEntries.sh: The three heads take turns sinking their teeth into the opponent. Their attacks won’t slow until their target goes down.
